body.name: worked heterogeneous-baseline completion
body.construction: Let \(I=[-1,1]\) and \(K=L=M=1\). The observed law \(P^{\diamond}\) assigns probability \(1/2\) to each of \((Y_1,Y_2,D_1,D_2)=(0,0,-1/2,0)\) and \((0,0,1/2,0)\). For any function \(u\) on \(\{-1/2,1/2\}\), set \(b_u^{\diamond}=-2u(-1/2)\) when \(X=-1/2\) and \(b_u^{\diamond}=2u(1/2)\) when \(X=1/2\), and define the one-argument schedules of \(Q_u^{\diamond}\) by \(Y_1^{Q_u^{\diamond}}(d)=b_u^{\diamond}(d-D_1)\) and \(Y_2^{Q_u^{\diamond}}(d)=b_u^{\diamond}(d-D_2)\) for \(d\in[-1,1]\), while retaining the observed law \(P^{\diamond}\).
